Felien
The smell inside the factory is much worse than\noutside...
It really stinks... I... I'm gonna die...
Hey, are you alright?! It's intolerable even for us.\nI know how you feel... Just a second.
...Good.\nLooks awkward but it should be better, huh?
Y-Yea... But what is this?!
Small corks are put in Pelulu's nostrils...
They were used for empty medicine bottles.\nLooks like they are the right size.
Hey, what are you doing to a girl's nose!!
You want me to put them out?
Ugg... There's no other way.\nLet's move on.
It's the fellows of the annoying flies.\nYou've come this far...
It's the fellows of the annoying flies.\nYou've come this far...\nHow rare to see that guy, huh?
It's been a while, Balft.\nOh, maybe you're called a black night recently, huh?\nHow does it feel to be called a hero?
What? What? What does that mean??
Whoaaaaa?!
Why are you here?\nWhere's the princess today?
What? What? Y-You know her?
That's my line, Felien.\nAn elite black knight has to guard such a filthy\nplace...?
Shut up!\nIt's just an order!!
The Demi Machinas being created in here are\ndisgusting stuffs. I don't wanna call them weapons!
This place is not a factory at all. It's much more\ndisgusting and filthy than a slaughterhouse. It's\ndesecrating human life. Always smells like blood...
I was assigned to such a place, so I'm pretty\nirritated, you know?
Well, okay. I think it's not worthwhile guarding.\nAnd I don't need to secure here if you destroy\nthis place...
How? It's easy. There are self-destruct buttons\nsomewhere in the back... Just do as you like.
Hey, what's going on?!\nExplain it, huh?
Oh, well...
You've been helping us so much.\nI guess I shouldn't keep it secret any longer...
I am one of the black knights of Lyark Technista\njust like Felien...
S-So, you're our enemy?!\nYou've been traveling to spy on other countries?!
Calm down. If I was a spy, I would've assassinated\nyou already since we meet everywhere else we go...
I'm currently leaving the troop for another\nmission.
What's that?
It's... I can't say it now.\nAnd I have no time for explaining that.\nI'm sorry.
You're gonna come to Lyark, right?\nI'll tell you when you meet there.\nDon't fall down on your way...
...Am I gonna meet as an enemy in Lyark, you ask?\n...I don't know.
Before that, it's not easy to come into the Empire.\nThink about it at first... See ya...
Meh... Why not help us sneak in if you think\nwe've been helpful...
Arrggghh! It's frustrating!!\nLet's find out the self-destruct buttons and\nblow it off! You got it?
